ATTEMPTS-T1.sentence: A courier makes at most two delivery attempts per parcel.
After the second failed attempt the parcel is taken to the local depot.

ATTEMPTS-T2.sentence: A courier makes at most two delivery attempts per parcel.
After the second failed attempt the parcel is taken to the local depot.
A delivered parcel is recorded with the recipient's signature.
Signature records are kept for 90 days.

AUDIT-T1.sentence: A job's audit record is deleted automatically 30 days after the job ends.
Only a compliance officer may delete a job's audit record earlier.

CANCEL-NOTE-T2.sentence: A request to cancel a job that has already finished is refused.

CANCEL-T1.sentence: The owner of a scheduled job, or an administrator, may cancel it.
Once a job is cancelled, none of its future runs is started.

CAPTURE-T1.sentence: A card payment is captured when the order is dispatched, not when it is placed.

CARD-CHECK-T1.sentence: A new payment card is checked with a zero-amount authorisation before it is saved.

CHARGEBACK-T1.sentence: A chargeback must be answered within 7 days of the card network's notice.

CONVERSION-T1.sentence: A payment made in a foreign currency is converted at that day's reference exchange rate.

CUSTOMER-REFUND-T1.sentence: A customer who returns an order is refunded the price paid for the returned items.

DAMAGE-T1.sentence: A sender whose parcel arrives damaged is refunded the declared value of the contents.
The damage must be reported within 48 hours of delivery.

An idle session expires after 30 minutes.

FAQ-T2.sentence: How long can a portal session stay idle?
A session that stays idle for 30 minutes is ended.

FRAUD-HOLD-T1.sentence: An order flagged by fraud screening is held until an analyst has reviewed it.

GIFT-CARD-T1.sentence: A gift card can pay for any order.
A gift card balance never expires.

H-T1.sentence: A producer or operator may cancel a job.
Cancellation stops Orion from investing further effort in the job, but Orion does not forcibly abort work that a worker is already performing.
After a job is cancelled, no future execution attempt of that job may be started.
Cancellation must not interrupt an execution attempt that is already running; that attempt runs to its own completion, failure or timeout.

H-T1.non_operative_reason: illustrative example that restates listed rules and adds none
H-T1.sentence: Job J-8 is cancelled while its second attempt is running.

H-T1.non_operative_reason: illustrative example that restates listed rules and adds none
H-T1.sentence: The second attempt continues; when it ends, no third attempt is started.

H-T9.sentence: Producers and operators can cancel jobs.
Cancellation tells Orion to stop investing in the job; it does not reach into a worker and abort work already under way.
Because producers retry their own requests, Orion may receive the same cancellation more than once; a repeated cancellation is simply acknowledged.
After a job is cancelled, no future execution attempt of that job may be started.
Cancellation must not interrupt an execution attempt that is already running; that attempt runs to its own completion, failure or timeout.
If Orion receives a cancellation for a job that is already cancelled, the job must remain cancelled and the repeated cancellation must not otherwise change the job's state.

H-T9.non_operative_reason: illustrative example that restates listed rules and adds none
H-T9.sentence: Q-40 is cancelled while its second execution is running; that execution finishes on its own terms and no further execution follows.

H-T9.non_operative_reason: illustrative example that restates listed rules and adds none
H-T9.sentence: A second cancellation for Q-40 arrives a minute later; Q-40 stays cancelled and nothing else about Q-40 changes.

HANDBOOK-T1.sentence: An idle customer-portal session expires after 15 minutes.

HANDBOOK-T2.sentence: Customer-portal sessions are ended after 15 minutes without any activity.

INSTALMENTS-T1.sentence: An order may be paid in three monthly instalments.

INVOICE-T1.sentence: Every order placed by a business customer receives a VAT invoice.

LABEL-T1.sentence: Every parcel must carry a printed label before it is collected.
The label shows the destination postcode.

LABEL-T2.sentence: Every parcel must carry a printed label before it is collected.
The label shows the destination postcode.
The label also carries a barcode that encodes the parcel's tracking number.

LATE-NOTE-T2.sentence: A sender must ask for the late-delivery refund within 14 days of the promised delivery date.

LATE-T1.sentence: If a parcel is delivered later than the promised date, the sender is refunded the shipping fee.
The refund is paid to the payment method used for the booking.

PAYOUT-T1.sentence: Sellers are paid out every Friday.
A payout is made only when the seller's balance is at least 20 GBP.

PICKUP-T1.sentence: A pickup requested before 14:00 local time is collected on the same working day.
A pickup requested at or after 14:00 local time is collected on the next working day.

PICKUP-T2.sentence: Collection happens on the same working day for any pickup booked earlier than 2 p.m. local time.
Pickups booked at 2 p.m. local time or later are collected on the following working day.

PRICE-VAT-T1.sentence: Prices shown to consumers include VAT.

PROMO-T1.sentence: Only one promotional code can be applied to an order.

RETRY-T1.sentence: A failed subscription payment is tried again 3 days later.

RETURNS-NOTE-T2.sentence: The original delivery charge is also repaid to a customer who returns an order.

SELLER-LIMIT-T1.sentence: A new seller account may receive at most 1,000 GBP in payments during its first 30 days.

SETTLEMENT-T1.sentence: Approved compensation payments are sent to the bank in a settlement run at 17:00 on each working day.
A payment approved after 17:00 is sent in the next working day's settlement run.

STORE-CREDIT-T1.sentence: Store credit expires 12 months after it is issued.

SUPPLIER-OVERPAYMENT-T1.sentence: A supplier that has been paid more than its invoice total must pay the excess back.

WEIGHT-T1.sentence: A single parcel may weigh at most 30 kg.
A parcel over the weight limit is refused at pickup.

WEIGHT-T2.sentence: A single parcel may weigh at most 25 kg.
A parcel over the weight limit is refused at pickup.
